en: The world will never be the same.
zh: 世界將永遠改變。
ja: 世界は決して同じにはならない。
local: The world will never be the same.
ja_pron: Sekai wa kesshite onaji ni wa naranai.
native: The world will never be the same.

en: In the closing years of the 19th century, the world was entering the Electric Revolution.
zh: 在19世紀末期，世界正進入電氣革命。
ja: 19世紀の終わり頃、世界は電気革命の時代に入っていた。
local: In the closing years of the 19th century, the world was entering the Electric Revolution.
ja_pron: 19 seiki no owari goro, sekai wa denki kakumei no jidai ni haitte ita.
native: In the closing years of the 19th century, the world was entering the Electric Revolution.

en: In the United States, a fierce contest raged over Electric Power Transmission.
zh: 在美國，電力傳輸引發激烈競爭。
ja: アメリカでは、電力送電を巡って激しい争いが繰り広げられていた。
local: In the United States, a fierce contest raged over Electric Power Transmission.
ja_pron: Amerika de wa, denryoku sōden o megutte hageshii arasoi ga kurihirogerarete ita.
native: In the United States, a fierce contest raged over Electric Power Transmission.

en: The War of the Currents.
zh: 電流戰爭。
ja: 電流戦争。
local: The War of the Currents.
ja_pron: Denryū sensō.
native: The War of the Currents.

en: On one side, Thomas Edison advocated direct current, or DC.
zh: 一方，托馬斯·愛迪生主張直流電，簡稱DC。
ja: 一方では、トーマス・エジソンが直流電流（DC）を支持していた。
local: On one side, Thomas Edison advocated direct current, or DC.
ja_pron: Ippō de wa, Tōmasu Ejison ga chokuryū denryū (DC) o shiji shite ita.
native: On one side, Thomas Edison advocated direct current, or DC.

en: On the other, Nikola Tesla and George Westinghouse promoted alternating current, or AC,
zh: 另一方，尼古拉·特斯拉和喬治·威斯汀豪斯推廣交流電，簡稱AC，
ja: もう一方では、ニコラ・テスラとジョージ・ウェスティングハウスが交流電流（AC）を推進していた。
local: On the other, Nikola Tesla and George Westinghouse promoted alternating current, or AC,
ja_pron: Mō ippō de wa, Nikora Tesura to Jōji Wesutinguhausu ga kōryū denryū (AC) o suishin shite ita.
native: On the other, Nikola Tesla and George Westinghouse promoted alternating current, or AC,

en: which could travel long distances more efficiently, and was far less hazardous over high-voltage
zh: 交流電能更有效率地傳輸長距離，且在高壓線路上危險性較低。
ja: 交流電流は長距離をより効率的に伝送でき、高電圧の送電線でもはるかに安全だった。
local: which could travel long distances more efficiently, and was far less hazardous over high-voltage
ja_pron: Kōryū denryū wa chōkyori o yori kōritsuteki ni densō deki, kōden'atsu no sōdensen demo haruka ni anzen datta.
native: which could travel long distances more efficiently, and was far less hazardous over high-voltage

en: lines.
zh: 線路。
ja: 送電線だった。
local: lines.
ja_pron: Sōdensen datta.
native: lines.

en: By the dawn of the 20th century, AC had prevailed, lighting modern cities worldwide.
zh: 到了20世紀初，交流電已經勝出，照亮全球現代城市。
ja: 20世紀の夜明けまでに、交流電流が勝利し、世界中の現代都市を照らした。
local: By the dawn of the 20th century, AC had prevailed, lighting modern cities worldwide.
ja_pron: 20 seiki no yoake made ni, kōryū denryū ga shōri shi, sekaijū no gendai toshi o terashita.
native: By the dawn of the 20th century, AC had prevailed, lighting modern cities worldwide.

en: Although Edison didn't win that battle, his work on the Electric Light bulb led to an unexpected
zh: 雖然愛迪生未贏得那場戰役，但他在電燈泡上的研究帶來了意想不到的
ja: エジソンはその戦いに勝てなかったが、電球の研究は予期せぬ
local: Although Edison didn't win that battle, his work on the Electric Light bulb led to an unexpected
ja_pron: Ejison wa sono tatakai ni katenakatta ga, denkyū no kenkyū wa yoki senu
native: Although Edison didn't win that battle, his work on the Electric Light bulb led to an unexpected

en: discovery, one that would ultimately pave the way for the electronics of the future.
zh: 發現，最終為未來電子學鋪路。
ja: 発見をもたらし、それが最終的に未来の電子技術の道を開いた。
local: discovery, one that would ultimately pave the way for the electronics of the future.
ja_pron: Hakken o motarashi, sore ga saishūteki ni mirai no denshi gijutsu no michi o hiraita.
native: discovery, one that would ultimately pave the way for the electronics of the future.

en: Out of Edison's humble incandescent lamps appeared a strange phenomenon.
zh: 從愛迪生簡陋的白熾燈泡中出現了一種奇怪的現象。
ja: エジソンの質素な白熱電球から奇妙な現象が現れた。
local: Out of Edison's humble incandescent lamps appeared a strange phenomenon.
ja_pron: Ejison no shisso na hakunetsu denkyū kara kimyō na genshō ga arawareta.
native: Out of Edison's humble incandescent lamps appeared a strange phenomenon.

en: When the filament was heated white hot with direct current, the bulbs interior eventually
zh: 當燈絲用直流電加熱到白熱時，燈泡內部最終
ja: フィラメントが直流電流で白熱すると、電球の内部は最終的に
local: When the filament was heated white hot with direct current, the bulbs interior eventually
ja_pron: Firamento ga chokuryū denryū de hakunetsu suru to, denkyū no naibu wa saishūteki ni
native: When the filament was heated white hot with direct current, the bulbs interior eventually

en: darkened on one side, as tiny particles from the filament deposited on the glass.
zh: 一側變暗，因為來自燈絲的微小粒子沉積在玻璃上。
ja: 一方の側面が暗くなり、フィラメントからの微小な粒子がガラスに付着した。
local: darkened on one side, as tiny particles from the filament deposited on the glass.
ja_pron: Ippō no sokumen ga kuraku nari, firamento kara no bishō na ryūshi ga garasu ni fuchaku shita.
native: darkened on one side, as tiny particles from the filament deposited on the glass.

en: Working to address it, Edison observed that a current could pass through a partial vacuum
zh: 為了解決這個問題，愛迪生觀察到電流可以通過部分真空
ja: これに対処するために、エジソンは電流が部分的な真空を通過できることを観察した。
local: Working to address it, Edison observed that a current could pass through a partial vacuum
ja_pron: Kore ni taisho suru tame ni, Ejison wa denryū ga bubun-teki na shinkū o tsūka dekiru koto o kansatsu shita.
native: Working to address it, Edison observed that a current could pass through a partial vacuum

en: from the hot filament to a nearby metal plate, an effect he filed a patent for in 1883.
zh: 從熱燈絲到附近的金屬板，他於1883年為此效果申請了專利。
ja: 熱いフィラメントから近くの金属板へ電流が流れる現象で、1883年に特許を申請した。
local: from the hot filament to a nearby metal plate, an effect he filed a patent for in 1883.
ja_pron: Atsui firamento kara chikaku no kinzoku ban e denryū ga nagareru genshō de, 1883-nen ni tokkyō o shinsei shita.
native: from the hot filament to a nearby metal plate, an effect he filed a patent for in 1883.

en: Want broad claims on using the current give us that by heated vacuum lamps for this purpose
zh: 他希望對使用該電流的加熱真空燈泡提出廣泛的權利要求，適用於此目的
ja: この目的のために加熱された真空ランプでこの電流を使用することに関して広範な権利を求めた。
local: Want broad claims on using the current give us that by heated vacuum lamps for this purpose
ja_pron: Kono mokuteki no tame ni kanetsu sareta shinkū ranpu de kono denryū o shiyō suru koto ni kanshite kōhan na kenri o motometa.
native: Want broad claims on using the current give us that by heated vacuum lamps for this purpose

en: and other purposes?
zh: 以及其他用途？
ja: そして他の目的にも？
local: and other purposes?
ja_pron: Soshite hoka no mokuteki ni mo?
native: and other purposes?

en: Later known as the Edison effect, though he could not foresee its destiny.
zh: 後來被稱為愛迪生效應，儘管他無法預見其未來。
ja: 後にエジソン効果として知られるが、彼はその運命を予見できなかった。
local: Later known as the Edison effect, though he could not foresee its destiny.
ja_pron: Ato ni Ejison kōka to shite shirareru ga, kare wa sono unmei o yoken dekinakatta.
native: Later known as the Edison effect, though he could not foresee its destiny.

en: I have just completed a pressure indicator which works perfectly.
zh: 我剛完成一個運作完美的壓力指示器。
ja: 私はちょうど完璧に動作する圧力計を完成させたところだ。
local: I have just completed a pressure indicator which works perfectly.
ja_pron: Watashi wa chōdo kanpeki ni dōsa suru atsuryoku-kei o kansei saseta tokoro da.
native: I have just completed a pressure indicator which works perfectly.

en: Following this discovery, engineers began experimenting with the plate's placement and
zh: 在這項發現之後，工程師開始嘗試調整金屬板的位置並
ja: この発見に続き、技術者たちは金属板の配置を試行し始め、
local: Following this discovery, engineers began experimenting with the plate's placement and
ja_pron: Kono hakken ni tsudzuki, gijutsusha-tachi wa kinzoku ban no haichi o shikō shi hajime,
native: Following this discovery, engineers began experimenting with the plate's placement and

en: designed to better capture the particles and prevent the darkening.
zh: 設計出更能捕捉粒子並防止變暗的方法。
ja: 粒子をよりよく捕らえ、暗くなるのを防ぐ設計を行った。
local: designed to better capture the particles and prevent the darkening.
ja_pron: Ryūshi o yori yoku torae, kuraku naru no o fusegu sekkei o okonatta.
native: designed to better capture the particles and prevent the darkening.

en: This laid the groundwork for the vacuum tube era.
zh: 這為真空管時代奠定了基礎。
ja: これが真空管時代の基礎を築いた。
local: This laid the groundwork for the vacuum tube era.
ja_pron: Kore ga shinkūkan jidai no kiso o kizuita.
native: This laid the groundwork for the vacuum tube era.

en: In 1906, leader forest added a third electrode, the grid, inventing the triode, the first
zh: 1906年，李德福斯特增加了第三個電極——柵極，發明了三極管，這是第一個
ja: 1906年、リーダー・フォレストは第三の電極であるグリッドを追加し、初の三極管を発明した。
local: In 1906, leader forest added a third electrode, the grid, inventing the triode, the first
ja_pron: 1906-nen, Rīdā Foresuto wa dai san no denkyoku de aru guriddo o tsuika shi, hatsu no sankyokukan o hatsumei shita.
native: In 1906, leader forest added a third electrode, the grid, inventing the triode, the first

en: vacuum tube capable of amplifying electrical signals.
zh: 能放大電信號的真空管。
ja: 電気信号を増幅できる真空管だ。
local: vacuum tube capable of amplifying electrical signals.
ja_pron: Denki shingō o zōfuku dekiru shinkūkan da.
native: vacuum tube capable of amplifying electrical signals.

en: By placing a wire mesh grid between the heated cathode and the plate, he could control
zh: 透過將金屬網柵放置於加熱的陰極與金屬板之間，他能控制
ja: 加熱された陰極とプレートの間にワイヤーメッシュのグリッドを置くことで、彼は制御できた。
local: By placing a wire mesh grid between the heated cathode and the plate, he could control
ja_pron: Kanetsu sareta inkyoku to purēto no aida ni waiyā messhu no guriddo o oku koto de, kare wa seigyo dekita.
native: By placing a wire mesh grid between the heated cathode and the plate, he could control

en: the flow of electricity, turning faint currents into strong, usable signals.
zh: 電流的流動，將微弱電流轉變為強大且可用的信號。
ja: 電気の流れを制御し、微弱な電流を強力で使える信号に変えた。
local: the flow of electricity, turning faint currents into strong, usable signals.
ja_pron: Denki no nagare o seigyo shi, bijaku na denryū o kyōryoku de tsukaeru shingō ni kaeta.
native: the flow of electricity, turning faint currents into strong, usable signals.

en: Triodes transformed communication.
zh: 三極管改變了通訊方式。
ja: 三極管は通信を変革した。
local: Triodes transformed communication.
ja_pron: Sankyokukan wa tsūshin o henkaku shita.
native: Triodes transformed communication.

en: They gave birth to the modern radio, enabled long distance to lefony, and connected continents.
zh: 它們催生了現代無線電，實現了長距離通話，並連接了大陸。
ja: それらは現代のラジオを生み出し、長距離通信を可能にし、大陸を繋いだ。
local: They gave birth to the modern radio, enabled long distance to lefony, and connected continents.
ja_pron: Sorera wa gendai no rajio o umidashi, chōkyori tsūshin o kanō ni shi, tairiku o tsunaida.
native: They gave birth to the modern radio, enabled long distance to lefony, and connected continents.

en: A small change of the grid could regulate a much larger current between cathode and plate,
zh: 柵極的微小變化可以調節陰極與金屬板之間更大的電流，
ja: グリッドの小さな変化が陰極とプレート間のより大きな電流を調整できた。
local: A small change of the grid could regulate a much larger current between cathode and plate,
ja_pron: Guriddo no chīsana henka ga inkyoku to purēto kan no yori ōkina denryū o chōsei dekita.
native: A small change of the grid could regulate a much larger current between cathode and plate,

en: a principle that was truly revolutionary.
zh: 這是一個真正革命性的原理。
ja: これは真に革命的な原理だった。
local: a principle that was truly revolutionary.
ja_pron: Kore wa shin ni kakumeiteki na genri datta.
native: a principle that was truly revolutionary.

en: Yet these early tubes remained fragile, bulky, and power-hungry.
zh: 然而這些早期的真空管仍然脆弱、笨重且耗電。
ja: しかしこれらの初期の管は壊れやすく、かさばり、電力を大量に消費した。
local: Yet these early tubes remained fragile, bulky, and power-hungry.
ja_pron: Shikashi korera no shoki no kan wa koware yasuku, kasabari, denryoku o tairyo ni shōhi shita.
native: Yet these early tubes remained fragile, bulky, and power-hungry.

en: By the 1940s, the promise of electronic amplification had grown into something huge.
zh: 到了1940年代，電子放大的前景已經變得巨大。
ja: 1940年代までに、電子増幅の可能性は巨大なものへと成長した。
local: By the 1940s, the promise of electronic amplification had grown into something huge.
ja_pron: 1940-nendai made ni, denshi zōfuku no kanōsei wa kyodai na mono e to seichō shita.
native: By the 1940s, the promise of electronic amplification had grown into something huge.

en: Things like the electronic numerical integrator and computer relied on tens of thousands
zh: 像電子數值積分器和電腦這樣的設備依賴數以萬計的
ja: 電子数値積分器やコンピューターのようなものは、数万台の
local: Things like the electronic numerical integrator and computer relied on tens of thousands
ja_pron: Denshi sūchi sekibunki ya konpyūtā no yō na mono wa, sūman dai no
native: Things like the electronic numerical integrator and computer relied on tens of thousands

en: of vacuum tubes to perform calculations, filling entire rooms with blinking panels and glowing
zh: 真空管來執行計算，整個房間充滿閃爍的面板和發光的
ja: 真空管に依存して計算を行い、部屋全体が点滅するパネルと光る
local: of vacuum tubes to perform calculations, filling entire rooms with blinking panels and glowing
ja_pron: Shinkūkan ni izon shite keisan o okonai, heya zentai ga tenmetsu suru paneru to hikaru
native: of vacuum tubes to perform calculations, filling entire rooms with blinking panels and glowing

en: filaments.
zh: 燈絲充滿。
ja: フィラメントで満たされていた。
local: filaments.
ja_pron: Firamento de mitasarete ita.
native: filaments.

en: These power-hungry machines consumed massive amounts of electricity and required constant
zh: 這些耗電量大的機器消耗大量電力，並需要不斷的
ja: これらの電力を大量に消費する機械は大量の電気を消費し、絶え間ない
local: These power-hungry machines consumed massive amounts of electricity and required constant
ja_pron: Korera no denryoku o tairyo ni shōhi suru kikai wa tairyo no denki o shōhi shi, taemanai
native: These power-hungry machines consumed massive amounts of electricity and required constant

en: maintenance, as tubes frequently burned out or failed.
zh: 維護，因為真空管經常燒壞或故障。
ja: メンテナンスを必要とした。管は頻繁に焼き切れたり故障した。
local: maintenance, as tubes frequently burned out or failed.
ja_pron: Mentenasu o hitsuyō to shita. Kan wa hinpan ni yakikire tari koshō shita.
native: maintenance, as tubes frequently burned out or failed.

en: Computers were searching for something smaller and far more reliable.
zh: 電腦正在尋找更小且更可靠的東西。
ja: コンピューターはより小さく、はるかに信頼性の高いものを探していた。
local: Computers were searching for something smaller and far more reliable.
ja_pron: Konpyūtā wa yori chiisaku, haruka ni shinraisei no takai mono o sagashite ita.
native: Computers were searching for something smaller and far more reliable.

en: At Bell Telephone Laboratories, John Bardeen, Walter Brittain, and William Shockley developed
zh: 在貝爾電話實驗室，約翰·巴丁、沃爾特·布里坦和威廉·肖克利開發了
ja: ベル電話研究所で、ジョン・バーディーン、ウォルター・ブリテン、ウィリアム・ショックリーが開発した。
local: At Bell Telephone Laboratories, John Bardeen, Walter Brittain, and William Shockley developed
ja_pron: Beru denwa kenkyūjo de, Jon Bādīn, Uorutā Buriten, Uiriamu Shokkuri ga kaihatsu shita.
native: At Bell Telephone Laboratories, John Bardeen, Walter Brittain, and William Shockley developed

en: a new kind of amplifier, the transistor.
zh: 一種新型放大器——晶體管。
ja: 新しいタイプの増幅器、トランジスタを。
local: a new kind of amplifier, the transistor.
ja_pron: Atarashii taipu no zōfuku-ki, toranjisuta o.
native: a new kind of amplifier, the transistor.

en: The transistor, operating on a new and different principle, arising from basic research
zh: 晶體管基於一種新的不同原理，源自基礎研究，
ja: トランジスタは新しく異なる原理で動作し、基礎研究から生まれた。
local: The transistor, operating on a new and different principle, arising from basic research
ja_pron: Toranjisuta wa atarashiku kotonaru genri de dōsa shi, kiso kenkyū kara umareta.
native: The transistor, operating on a new and different principle, arising from basic research

en: on solid substances and how the electrons inside them behave, investigating the surface properties
zh: 研究固體物質及其內部電子的行為，調查表面特性，
ja: 固体物質とその中の電子の振る舞いを研究し、表面特性を調査した。
local: on solid substances and how the electrons inside them behave, investigating the surface properties
ja_pron: Kotai busshitsu to sono naka no denshi no furumai o kenkyū shi, hyōmen tokusei o chōsa shita.
native: on solid substances and how the electrons inside them behave, investigating the surface properties

en: of germanium, a substance known to be a semiconductor of electricity, their studies suggested
zh: 對鍺的研究，鍺是一種已知的半導體，他們的研究提出了
ja: 電気の半導体として知られるゲルマニウムの表面特性を調査し、彼らの研究は示唆した。
local: of germanium, a substance known to be a semiconductor of electricity, their studies suggested
ja_pron: Denki no handōtai to shite shirareru Gerumaniumu no hyōmen tokusei o chōsa shi, karera no kenkyū wa shisa shita.
native: of germanium, a substance known to be a semiconductor of electricity, their studies suggested

en: a way to amplify an electric current within a solid.
zh: 一種在固體內放大電流的方法。
ja: 固体内で電流を増幅する方法を。
local: a way to amplify an electric current within a solid.
ja_pron: Kotai-nai de denryū o zōfuku suru hōhō o.
native: a way to amplify an electric current within a solid.

en: The transistor was born.
zh: 晶體管誕生了。
ja: トランジスタが誕生した。
local: The transistor was born.
ja_pron: Toranjisuta ga tanjō shita.
native: The transistor was born.

en: Bell Labs coined the name transistor, combining transconductance and varister.
zh: 貝爾實驗室創造了「transistor」這個名稱，結合了跨導和變阻器。
ja: ベル研究所は「トランジスタ」という名前を作り出し、トランスコンダクタンスとバリスターを組み合わせた。
local: Bell Labs coined the name transistor, combining transconductance and varister.
ja_pron: Beru kenkyūjo wa 'toranjisuta' to iu namae o tsukuridashi, toransukondakutansu to barisutā o kumiawaseta.
native: Bell Labs coined the name transistor, combining transconductance and varister.

en: Other proposed names included the semiconductor triode.
zh: 其他提議的名稱包括半導體三極管。
ja: 他に提案された名前には半導体三極管が含まれていた。
local: Other proposed names included the semiconductor triode.
ja_pron: Hoka ni teian sareta namae ni wa handōtai sankyokukan ga fukumarete ita.
native: Other proposed names included the semiconductor triode.

en: In 1947, they unveiled the first working prototype, a PNP point contact transistor made
zh: 1947年，他們展示了第一個可工作的原型，一種PNP點接觸晶體管，製造於
ja: 1947年、彼らは最初の動作する試作品、PNPポイントコンタクトトランジスタを公開した。
local: In 1947, they unveiled the first working prototype, a PNP point contact transistor made
ja_pron: 1947-nen, karera wa saisho no dōsa suru shisaku-hin, PNP pointo kontakuto toranjisuta o kōkai shita.
native: In 1947, they unveiled the first working prototype, a PNP point contact transistor made

en: from germanium instead of vacuum tubes.
zh: 由鍺製成，取代了真空管。
ja: 真空管の代わりにゲルマニウムで作られた。
local: from germanium instead of vacuum tubes.
ja_pron: Shinkūkan no kawari ni Gerumaniumu de tsukurareta.
native: from germanium instead of vacuum tubes.

en: This is one of the latest transistors, a much more sophisticated device, but based on the
zh: 這是最新的晶體管之一，一種更先進的裝置，但基於
ja: これは最新のトランジスタの一つで、はるかに高度な装置だが、
local: This is one of the latest transistors, a much more sophisticated device, but based on the
ja_pron: Kore wa saishin no toranjisuta no hitotsu de, haruka ni kōdo na sōchi da ga,
native: This is one of the latest transistors, a much more sophisticated device, but based on the

en: same physical principles as its ancestor.
zh: 與其祖先相同的物理原理。
ja: その先祖と同じ物理的原理に基づいている。
local: same physical principles as its ancestor.
ja_pron: Sono senzo to onaji butsuri-teki genri ni motozuite iru.
native: same physical principles as its ancestor.

en: The impact of the transistor on the electronic industry and on our society is unquestioned.
zh: 晶體管對電子產業及社會的影響是無可置疑的。
ja: トランジスタが電子産業と社会に与えた影響は疑いようがない。
local: The impact of the transistor on the electronic industry and on our society is unquestioned.
ja_pron: Toranjisuta ga denshi sangyō to shakai ni ataeta eikyō wa utagai yō ga nai.
native: The impact of the transistor on the electronic industry and on our society is unquestioned.

en: Their transistor worked on a principle similar to the triode.
zh: 他們的晶體管運作原理類似三極管。
ja: 彼らのトランジスタは三極管に似た原理で動作した。
local: Their transistor worked on a principle similar to the triode.
ja_pron: Karera no toranjisuta wa sankyokukan ni nita genri de dōsa shita.
native: Their transistor worked on a principle similar to the triode.

en: A small input of the transistor's base could control a much larger current flowing between
zh: 晶體管基極的小輸入可以控制流經
ja: トランジスタのベースへの小さな入力が、間を流れるより大きな電流を制御できた。
local: A small input of the transistor's base could control a much larger current flowing between
ja_pron: Toranjisuta no bēsu e no chīsana nyūryoku ga, aida o nagareru yori ōkina denryū o seigyo dekita.
native: A small input of the transistor's base could control a much larger current flowing between

en: the emitter and collector contacts of the germanium crystal.
zh: 鍺晶體的發射極與集電極接點之間的更大電流。
ja: ゲルマニウム結晶のエミッターとコレクターの接点間のより大きな電流を。
local: the emitter and collector contacts of the germanium crystal.
ja_pron: Gerumaniumu kesshō no emittā to korekutā no setten kan no yori ōkina denryū o.
native: the emitter and collector contacts of the germanium crystal.

en: In essence, the transistor was a solid state triode.
zh: 本質上，晶體管是一種固態三極管。
ja: 本質的に、トランジスタは固体状態の三極管だった。
local: In essence, the transistor was a solid state triode.
ja_pron: Honshitsu-teki ni, toranjisuta wa kotai jōtai no sankyokukan datta.
native: In essence, the transistor was a solid state triode.

en: The analogy to the triode's grid made its operation easier to understand, but now it
zh: 與三極管柵極的類比使其運作更易理解，但現在它
ja: 三極管のグリッドとの類推で動作が理解しやすくなったが、今やそれは
local: The analogy to the triode's grid made its operation easier to understand, but now it
ja_pron: Sankyokukan no guriddo to no ruisui de dōsa ga rikai shiyasuku natta ga, imaya sore wa
native: The analogy to the triode's grid made its operation easier to understand, but now it

en: was solid state, without the heat, bulk, or fragility of vacuum tubes, and without
zh: 是固態的，沒有真空管的熱量、笨重或脆弱，且沒有
ja: 固体状態であり、真空管の熱さ、かさばり、壊れやすさがなく、そして
local: was solid state, without the heat, bulk, or fragility of vacuum tubes, and without
ja_pron: Kotai jōtai de ari, shinkūkan no atsusa, kasabari, koware yasusa ga naku, soshite
native: was solid state, without the heat, bulk, or fragility of vacuum tubes, and without

en: filaments to burn out.
zh: 燈絲燒壞的問題。
ja: フィラメントが切れることもなかった。
local: filaments to burn out.
ja_pron: Firamento ga kireru koto mo nakatta.
native: filaments to burn out.

en: The three inventors were later awarded the 1956 Nobel Prize in Physics.
zh: 這三位發明家後來獲得了1956年諾貝爾物理學獎。
ja: この三人の発明者は後に1956年のノーベル物理学賞を受賞した。
local: The three inventors were later awarded the 1956 Nobel Prize in Physics.
ja_pron: Kono sannin no hatsumeisha wa nochi ni 1956-nen no Nōberu Butsurigakushō o jushō shita.
native: The three inventors were later awarded the 1956 Nobel Prize in Physics.

en: The invention of the transistor revolutionized computing.
zh: 晶體管的發明徹底改變了計算機技術。
ja: トランジスタの発明はコンピューター技術に革命をもたらした。
local: The invention of the transistor revolutionized computing.
ja_pron: Toranjisuta no hatsumei wa konpyūtā gijutsu ni kakumei o motarashita.
native: The invention of the transistor revolutionized computing.

en: By the late 1950s, transistors had moved beyond the laboratory.
zh: 到了1950年代末，晶體管已經走出實驗室。
ja: 1950年代後半までに、トランジスタは研究室の外に出ていた。
local: By the late 1950s, transistors had moved beyond the laboratory.
ja_pron: 1950-nendai kōhan made ni, toranjisuta wa kenkyūshitsu no soto ni dete ita.
native: By the late 1950s, transistors had moved beyond the laboratory.

en: Engineers began replacing bulky vacuum tubes with transistors, creating machines that were
zh: 工程師開始用晶體管取代笨重的真空管，製造出更
ja: 技術者たちはかさばる真空管をトランジスタに置き換え、より
local: Engineers began replacing bulky vacuum tubes with transistors, creating machines that were
ja_pron: Gijutsusha-tachi wa kasabaru shinkūkan o toranjisuta ni okikae, yori
native: Engineers began replacing bulky vacuum tubes with transistors, creating machines that were

en: faster, more compact, and far more reliable.
zh: 快速、更緊湊且更可靠的機器。
ja: 高速で、よりコンパクトで、はるかに信頼性の高い機械を作り出した。
local: faster, more compact, and far more reliable.
ja_pron: Kōsoku de, yori konpakuto de, haruka ni shinraisei no takai kikai o tsukuridashita.
native: faster, more compact, and far more reliable.

en: One landmark example was the IBM 7090, a fully transistorized computer introduced in 1959.
zh: 一個里程碑式的例子是IBM 7090，一台於1959年推出的全晶體管電腦。
ja: 画期的な例の一つがIBM 7090で、1959年に導入された完全トランジスタ化コンピューターだ。
local: One landmark example was the IBM 7090, a fully transistorized computer introduced in 1959.
ja_pron: Kakkiteki na rei no hitotsu ga IBM 7090 de, 1959-nen ni dōnyū sareta kanzen toranjisuta-ka konpyūtā da.
native: One landmark example was the IBM 7090, a fully transistorized computer introduced in 1959.

en: The IBM 7090 played a crucial role in space exploration.
zh: IBM 7090在太空探索中扮演了關鍵角色。
ja: IBM 7090は宇宙探査で重要な役割を果たした。
local: The IBM 7090 played a crucial role in space exploration.
ja_pron: IBM 7090 wa uchū tansa de jūyō na yakuwari o hatashita.
native: The IBM 7090 played a crucial role in space exploration.

en: NASA used it to perform the complex calculations needed to plan trajectories and guidance
zh: NASA使用它來執行規劃軌跡和導航所需的複雜計算，
ja: NASAは軌道や誘導システムの計画に必要な複雑な計算を行うために使用した。
local: NASA used it to perform the complex calculations needed to plan trajectories and guidance
ja_pron: NASA wa kidō ya yūdō shisutemu no keikaku ni hitsuyō na fukuzatsu na keisan o okonau tame ni shiyō shita.
native: NASA used it to perform the complex calculations needed to plan trajectories and guidance

en: systems for missions that would eventually take humans to the moon.
zh: 這些任務最終將把人類送上月球的系統。
ja: これらのミッションは最終的に人類を月に送るものだった。
local: systems for missions that would eventually take humans to the moon.
ja_pron: Korera no misshon wa saishūteki ni jinrui o tsuki ni okuru mono datta.
native: systems for missions that would eventually take humans to the moon.

en: This is the Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.
zh: 這是位於馬里蘭州格林貝爾特的高達太空飛行中心。
ja: ここはメリーランド州グリーンベルトにあるゴダード宇宙飛行センターだ。
local: This is the Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.
ja_pron: Koko wa Merīrando-shū Gurīnberuto ni aru Godādo Uchū Hikō Sentā da.
native: This is the Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland.

en: Through here, follows the voice and teletype communications that linked the global stations
zh: 這裡傳送著連結全球站點的語音和電傳打字通訊，
ja: ここを通じて、世界中の基地局を結ぶ音声とテレタイプ通信が行われている。
local: Through here, follows the voice and teletype communications that linked the global stations
ja_pron: Koko o tsūjite, sekaijū no kichikyoku o musubu onsei to tere-taipu tsūshin ga okonawarete iru.
native: Through here, follows the voice and teletype communications that linked the global stations

en: to mercury control.
zh: 連接到水星控制中心。
ja: マーキュリー管制センターに繋がっている。
local: to mercury control.
ja_pron: Mākyurī kansei sentā ni tsunagatte iru.
native: to mercury control.

en: The computers enable men to reach judgments within the flashes of time allowed for control
zh: 電腦使人們能在控制所允許的瞬間時間內做出判斷，
ja: コンピューターは、人間が制御に許された短い時間内に判断を下せるようにする。
local: The computers enable men to reach judgments within the flashes of time allowed for control
ja_pron: Konpyūtā wa, ningen ga seigyo ni yurusareta mijikai jikan-nai ni handan o kudaseru yō ni suru.
native: The computers enable men to reach judgments within the flashes of time allowed for control

en: of the spacecraft that moves faster than a brain can react.
zh: 控制這艘比大腦反應還快的太空船。
ja: 脳の反応よりも速く動く宇宙船の制御を。
local: of the spacecraft that moves faster than a brain can react.
ja_pron: Nō no hannō yori mo hayaku ugoku uchūsen no seigyo o.
native: of the spacecraft that moves faster than a brain can react.

en: Throughout the flight, the computers will generate recommendations on whether the mission
zh: 在整個飛行過程中，電腦將產生建議，判斷任務是否
ja: 飛行中、コンピューターはミッションを続行すべきか中止すべきかの推奨を生成する。
local: Throughout the flight, the computers will generate recommendations on whether the mission
ja_pron: Hikō-chū, konpyūtā wa misshon o zokkō subeki ka chūshi subeki ka no suishō o seisei suru.
native: Throughout the flight, the computers will generate recommendations on whether the mission

en: should continue or be aborted.
zh: 應該繼續還是中止。
ja: 続行すべきか中止すべきか。
local: should continue or be aborted.
ja_pron: Zokkō subeki ka chūshi subeki ka.
native: should continue or be aborted.

en: They will determine locations of the spacecraft.
zh: 它們將決定太空船的位置。
ja: 宇宙船の位置を決定する。
local: They will determine locations of the spacecraft.
ja_pron: Uchūsen no ichi o kettei suru.
native: They will determine locations of the spacecraft.

en: The time it should begin re-entry, the point at which it will end.
zh: 它應該開始再入大氣層的時間，以及結束的點。
ja: 再突入を開始すべき時間と終了する地点を。
local: The time it should begin re-entry, the point at which it will end.
ja_pron: Sai totsunyū o kaishi subeki jikan to shūryō suru chiten o.
native: The time it should begin re-entry, the point at which it will end.

en: Today is February 20, 1962, and today, if all goes well, the men here will launch an
zh: 今天是1962年2月20日，今天如果一切順利，這裡的人們將發射一艘
ja: 今日は1962年2月20日で、もしすべて順調なら、ここにいる人々は打ち上げるだろう。
local: Today is February 20, 1962, and today, if all goes well, the men here will launch an
ja_pron: Kyō wa 1962-nen 2-gatsu 20-nichi de, moshi subete junchō nara, koko ni iru hitobito wa uchiageru darou.
native: Today is February 20, 1962, and today, if all goes well, the men here will launch an

en: American astronaut in the orbit around the world in a spacecraft which he has named, Friendship
zh: 美國宇航員乘坐一艘名為「友誼號」的太空船繞地球軌道飛行。
ja: アメリカの宇宙飛行士が「フレンドシップ」と名付けた宇宙船で地球の軌道を周回する。
local: American astronaut in the orbit around the world in a spacecraft which he has named, Friendship
ja_pron: Amerika no uchū hikōshi ga 'Furendoshippu' to nadzuketa uchūsen de chikyū no kidō o shūkai suru.
native: American astronaut in the orbit around the world in a spacecraft which he has named, Friendship

en: Friendship 7 awaits its pilot.
zh: 友誼7號等待它的飛行員。
ja: フレンドシップ7号は操縦士を待っています。
local: Friendship 7 awaits its pilot.
native: Friendship 7 awaits its pilot.

en: His name is John Glenn.
zh: 他的名字是約翰·格倫。
ja: 彼の名前はジョン・グレンです。
local: His name is John Glenn.
native: His name is John Glenn.

en: All reporters do fast, team out as 18 seconds, and counting engines start.
zh: 所有記者迅速行動，團隊準備，倒數18秒，發動機啟動。
ja: すべての記者が素早く動き、チームは18秒のカウントダウンでエンジン始動を待っています。
local: All reporters do fast, team out as 18 seconds, and counting engines start.
native: All reporters do fast, team out as 18 seconds, and counting engines start.

en: Good Lord, ride all the way.
zh: 天啊，一路順利。
ja: 神よ、どうか無事に飛行できますように。
local: Good Lord, ride all the way.
native: Good Lord, ride all the way.

en: Just run your back up clock, get started.
zh: 只要啟動你的備用計時器，開始吧。
ja: バックアップクロックを動かして、始めてください。
local: Just run your back up clock, get started.
native: Just run your back up clock, get started.

en: Oh, that view is tremendous.
zh: 喔，那景色真是壯觀。
ja: ああ、その景色は素晴らしいです。
local: Oh, that view is tremendous.
native: Oh, that view is tremendous.

en: To John Glenn, now belongs an awesome panorama.
zh: 現在，約翰·格倫擁有一幅壯麗的全景。
ja: ジョン・グレンには、今や壮大なパノラマが広がっています。
local: To John Glenn, now belongs an awesome panorama.
native: To John Glenn, now belongs an awesome panorama.

en: The world curving beneath him, just as the with film of an earlier Mercury capsule.
zh: 世界在他腳下彎曲，就像早期水星太空艙的影片一樣。
ja: 彼の下に曲がる地球は、初期のマーキュリー宇宙船の映像のようです。
local: The world curving beneath him, just as the with film of an earlier Mercury capsule.
native: The world curving beneath him, just as the with film of an earlier Mercury capsule.

en: By the 1960s, transistors had become the foundation of modern electronics,
zh: 到了1960年代，晶體管已成為現代電子學的基礎，
ja: 1960年代までに、トランジスタは現代電子工学の基盤となっていました。
local: By the 1960s, transistors had become the foundation of modern electronics,
native: By the 1960s, transistors had become the foundation of modern electronics,

en: but the transistors' greatest promise lay in its destiny to shrink.
zh: 但晶體管最大的潛力在於它縮小的命運。
ja: しかし、トランジスタの最大の可能性は、その小型化にありました。
local: but the transistors' greatest promise lay in its destiny to shrink.
native: but the transistors' greatest promise lay in its destiny to shrink.

en: Engineers soon learned to carve not one, but millions of transistors into a single piece of silicon semiconductor.
zh: 工程師很快學會在一塊矽半導體上雕刻不止一個，而是數百萬個晶體管。
ja: 技術者たちはすぐに、1つではなく、数百万のトランジスタを1枚のシリコン半導体に刻み込む方法を学びました。
local: Engineers soon learned to carve not one, but millions of transistors into a single piece of silicon semiconductor.
native: Engineers soon learned to carve not one, but millions of transistors into a single piece of silicon semiconductor.

en: From these integrated circuits, the future of computing was born.
zh: 從這些積體電路中，計算的未來誕生了。
ja: これらの集積回路から、コンピューティングの未来が生まれました。
local: From these integrated circuits, the future of computing was born.
native: From these integrated circuits, the future of computing was born.

en: What began as a quirk in Edison's light bulb now pulses at the heart of every electronic device we use.
zh: 起初是愛迪生燈泡中的一個小巧思，現在跳動在我們使用的每一個電子裝置的核心。
ja: エジソンの電球の偶然の発見から始まったものが、今や私たちが使うすべての電子機器の中心で脈動しています。
local: What began as a quirk in Edison's light bulb now pulses at the heart of every electronic device we use.
native: What began as a quirk in Edison's light bulb now pulses at the heart of every electronic device we use.
